{{Quote|Keeping to themselves, Vindalians pay less attention to what's called the 'common' news than do many species. |[[Dejah Duare]] on [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Vlaçan Umber]]|<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>}}
'''Vindalians''' were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They appeared [[Human/Legends|Human]], but their facial features bore a vulpine resemblance. The [[Gender/Legends|females]] of the species were larger than the males, and size was considered a desirable quality in females.
